goal: See the customer's tier on the Case page
benefit: Agents treat higher-tier customers according to their tier
inScope: A Customer Tier picklist on Account, shown on the Case page

openQuestions.text: Which tier values does the business use?

acceptanceCriteria.given: an agent opens a Case on an Account with a tier
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tier shows quickly and properly

acceptanceCriteria.when: an agent reopens one of its Cases
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Case page shows the tier as needed
